messages:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME submitted an invoice dispute — a single API call shows up as two token usages. Spike at ~2026-03-12 13:12 UTC. cc @kevin_infra @sanjay_billing
kevin_infra: Can you paste the request id / sample payload + any client SDK version?
maria_support: request_id=rc_20260312_13_12_01_781, customer provided curl and SDK logs. SDK v0.9.1. Example: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"Summarize..."}'
```
Customer logs show first attempt returned 504 (timeout) then client retried automatically and got 200 — they attached billing screenshot showing two token lines.
sanjay_billing: Ledger shows two separate write events for that customer at 13:12:02 (write_id w_9812) and 13:12:05 (w_9813). Both have different meter IDs, so system counted twice.
ingress-gateway: I pulled gateway traces for rc_20260312_13_12_01_781 — we have two inbound requests within 4s. Both reached different backend workers. First request: connection closed by client before we wrote final response bytes. We did persist the idempotency key when first request arrived (key=123e4567... -> shard A). Second request came in 3s later and also had an idempotency header in the sample we have. However, guild logs are inconsistent: SDK trace shows header present on first attempt, but our request-level debug for the second attempt shows missing header.
kevin_infra: Interesting. I also see NLB connection resets at ~13:12:01-13:12:03 for that source IP range — TCP-level RSTs and brief spikes in active flows. Could be NLB idle/health probe behavior closing backend connection mid-response. If client retries but the SDK drops the custom header during its automatic retry path, we would get two independent server-side requests.
anna_research: Quick repro idea: run SDK v0.9.1 against staging while injecting a TCP RST during response to simulate NLB idle close. If the retry path drops idempotency header we can reproduce double meter writes.
kevin_infra: I'm running a quick controlled test now. Using `socat` to break the connection mid-stream. Repro steps: 1) hit gateway with X-Idempotency-Key header; 2) inject FIN mid-response; 3) let SDK auto-retry.
kevin_infra: Test result: SDK v0.9.1 retried and the second request omitted the X-Idempotency-Key header (confirmed by tcpdump). Gateway treated it as new request -> double billing.
maria_support: Customer claimed this is intermittent behind AWS NLB. Is this an SDK bug or gateway expectation?
kevin_infra: Root cause is client-side: SDK retry path loses the custom header on reconnect. Secondary contributor: gateway dedupe relies only on idempotency header canonicalization and a short TTL (10s). When second request arrives without header we can't detect duplication. Also, because writes are fast, two ledger writes completed before any dedupe barrier could be set if header absent.
sanjay_billing: We should treat this as double-bill and refund the customer. I'll prepare a credit and notify finance.
billing-bot: Refund created: refund_20260312_rc_981X — pending approval by finance.
kevin_infra: Short-term mitigations: 1) recommend customers upgrade SDK to v0.9.2 (patch incoming) which preserves idempotency headers across retries; 2) gateway hotfix: compute a body-hash fallback and check for recent identical request if idempotency header absent (will mitigate a subset of cases).
anna_research: Proposed server actions: a) increase idempotency-key TTL to 60s to reduce race window; b) add body-hash dedupe as Kevin said; c) add a metric/alert for 'requests with missing idempotency header after retry' so support can auto-flag.
kevin_infra: I created infra ticket INFRA-5821 to add body-hash dedupe + idempotency TTL bump. Pushed a hotfix branch for TTL bump to staging now.
maria_support: Customer refunded and notified. They asked for timeline to prevent recurrence. What ETA?
sanjay_billing: Refund completed, customer notified 13:45 UTC.
kevin_infra: ETA: SDK patch release in 2 hours (v0.9.2), gateway TTL bump to 60s deployed to prod in ~4 hours (after canary), body-hash dedupe scoped as a 2-day sprint for eng.
anna_research: Also logging note — captured reproduction artifacts and tcpdumps; uploaded to S3 under s3://redwood-debug/rc_20260312_13_12_01_781/ for postmortem.
maria_support: Thanks. Please add follow-up to postmortem and customer comms. I'll include timeline in the support case.
kevin_infra: Follow-ups: INFRA-5821 (body-hash dedupe), SDK-3245 (preserve headers on retry), PMR-114 (postmortem & comms). Assigning owners: Kevin->INFRA, Anna->SDK repro and test, Sanjay->billing refund confirmation.
maria_support: Marking resolved for support after refund + customer acceptance. Will reopen if they hit again. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Deployment event: prod TTL bump canary starts 2026-03-12T14:20:00Z.
